name: Happy Endings
description: Happy Endings is a vibrant venue that offers a unique karaoke experience blending a lively bar atmosphere with quality entertainment. The reviews highlight its well-curated drink menu, inviting ambiance, and friendly staff, making it a popular spot for both casual nights and special events. While it features live music and a welcoming environment, karaoke is available primarily during specific events, creating an exciting and engaging experience for guests seeking fun and memorable nights out.
